item.title: Charter trots out 'Invincible WiFi'
item.description: Charter has launched 'Invincible WiFi,' a service equipped with Wi-Fi 7 and 5G cellular and battery backup. It's bundled with the operator's 2-Gig service and available for $10 per month to 1-Gig customers and $20 per month to others #pressrelease

item.title: Optimum broadband sub losses worsen, video improves in Q4
item.description: Optimum saw broadband subscriber losses worsen to 62,200 in Q4 amid low churn and competition from fiber and FWA. Optimum intends to 'go on the offensive' in 2026 armed with simplified pricing and packaging, says CEO Dennis Mathew.

item.title: TECNO launches POVA curve 2 5G: Ultra-slim 7.42mm design meets 8000mAh mega battery
item.description: The TECNO POVA Curve 2 5G will be available in India in February 2026, with pricing and specifications announced at launch. Following its release, the device will be showcased at MWC 2026. #pressrelease.

item.title: Telecom billing is important, but product simplicity is paramount
item.description: Omdia's James Crawshaw takes issue with a recent column from Recon Analytics, noting that while telco billing does need improvement, it's a step too far to assert that bad billing is a major driver of churn or that good billing will improve NPS.

item.title: Eurobites: Telia fires up 5G SA across Norway
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: NATO picks Finland for connectivity hub; Ericsson touts in-car 5G router; Axian hooks up with Huawei.

item.title: The Buildout: Conexon receives BEAD dollars in Louisiana
item.description: This week in broadband builds: Conexon Connect receives part of its Louisiana BEAD grant; Comcast launches services in several states and starts new construction; Charter connections go live in Michigan and Wisconsin – and more.

item.title: Gigapower adds DojoNetworks to open access roster
item.description: DojoNetworks, a company that provides managed services to apartment buildings and other types of multiple-dwelling units (MDUs), is the latest service provider to hook into Gigapower's open access network.

item.title: Vertical Bridge closes tower-backed $1.94B ABS transaction
item.description: Vertical Bridge has completed a $1.94 billion asset-backed securities (ABS) financing secured by a portfolio of 10,425 tower sites. #pressrelease

item.title: Deutsche Telekom expands satellite IoT with multi-orbit first
item.description: Deutsche Telekom brings together Skylo, Sateliot, OQ Technology and Iridium for multi-orbit IoT connectivity across GEO, LEO and mobile networks.

item.title: Vecima forecasts revenue spike as cable network upgrades pick up
item.description: Canada's Vecima expects revenues to jump 20% to 30% in the coming 12 months as cable operators, including Charter, start to accelerate their HFC network upgrade programs.
